role: Prints the Swift files added/copied/modified/renamed in the current GitHub event's commit range, one per line.
toplevel: Whole script is top-level. Reads GITHUB_EVENT_NAME, PR_BASE_SHA, PUSH_BEFORE_SHA. pull_request/pull_request_target with base SHA -> range base...HEAD; push with non-null before SHA -> before...HEAD; otherwise HEAD~1...HEAD if HEAD~1 exists, else 'HEAD'. Runs `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR <range> -- '*.swift'`. set -euo pipefail so a git failure exits non-zero. Consumer: lint_changed_swift.sh (outside this chunk).
